topic: Three-dose ordinal unique-peak facets under weak individual unimodality. For every finite L>=2, define Q3,L as the convex hull of the three unique-best-dose indicators and the three randomized arm marginals over all ordinal response triples excluding a strict middle valley. Prove that one fixed CHECK_2BTAS-accepted two-pass bounded triangular-affine stream, with finite-state certificate labels and no arithmetic guards or semantic oracle, soundly, completely, and uniquely emits every primitive canonical cut or weighted facet. Derive finitely many geometric predecessor types and a fixed transfer recurrence for facet counts; then compute sharp coordinate endpoints and endpoint-attaining mixtures and construct exact support-aware simultaneous endpoint inference with pointwise scalar efficiency on separated positive-support faces. Consumer: Goodwin et al. 2022 three-dose psilocybin trial, using a prespecified ordinal benefit-risk outcome and reporting unimodality as an added assumption. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact prefix/suffix-minimum algebra yields 3^(L-3) distinct primitive weighted facets with unique affine predecessors and three successors; doubling and Fibonacci coefficient families survive exhaustive checks through L=9. Exact rational certificates give complete facet counts 59, 197, and 721 for L=3,4,5, and every coordinate endpoint reduces to affine combinations of at most three full facets, with three sometimes necessary. Boundary, tie, zero-cell, deletion, grammar-obstruction, generic-OT, and current-literature checks found no fatal collision with the final contract. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify every tight-product extremizer and rank pattern into finitely many geometric predecessor types whose affine extensions admit one sound, complete, uniquely generating 16-register two-pass triangular source, including the staircase/Fibonacci family. EARLY KILL TEST: Construct a literal accepted source for every three-letter staircase word, replay through L=9, and match it one-to-one against the exact L=3,4,5 catalogs; missing rows, duplicate traces, forbidden dependencies, or a proof excluding every permitted encoding forces pivot. open_problems.open_problem: Classify every primitive supporting inequality of the three-dose non-valley coupling polytope by finitely many predecessor types and compile the classification into one fixed bounded-register two-pass triangular-affine stream that emits every canonical facet or support-qualified cut exactly once for every ordinal support size.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The literature supplies pairwise ordinal transport formulas and generic finite causal-bound optimizers, but no analytic all-L H-representation for the three-marginal response-type projection with strict middle valleys removed. Prior CausalSmith runs expose both missing steps: verified finite-cell inequalities did not become a generic facet theorem, and exact recognition or parent evaluation did not become complete child generation. The load-bearing proof must replace bipartite Hall neighborhoods or generic reverse-search rays by a finite classification of tight three-way product-support extremizers, certify rank and boundary behavior, and prove that Q3,L-specific prefix/suffix states generate every primitive normal once without arithmetic guards or a semantic oracle. The reported staircase, doubling, Fibonacci, and small-L counts remain presolve hypotheses until this completeness and replay argument is established.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An irredundant all-L H-representation with necessary-and-sufficient rank qualifications, a finite predecessor-state classification, a literal accepted bounded-register two-pass triangular-affine program with inductive soundness, completeness, and unique-predecessor proofs, and a fixed transition recurrence whose initial values reproduce independently certified small-L catalogues.

writing_exemplar.why: Its motivation moves from substantively important discrete causal questions through the limits of bespoke algebra to systematic sharp-bound computation; the destination should sharpen that arc from numerical optimization to an exact reusable facet grammar.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Discrete causal questions defeat bespoke algebra -> response-type restrictions convert them into projection problems -> generic optimization lacks transparent all-L structure -> the three-dose non-valley model requires a certified canonical facet stream

method_exemplars.technique: Represent deterministic causal response types as a polytope and prove completeness of observable facet inequalities.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The target is likewise a complete observable facet system, with ordinal non-valley geometry supplying the additional structure needed for an all-L recurrence.

method_exemplars.technique: Use a canonical parent map and reverse-search traversal to prove exact-once enumeration without retaining a visited-output set.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The requested stream needs the same unique-predecessor logic, compiled into a bounded triangular-affine syntax specialized to the Q3,L facet family.

method_exemplars.technique: Perturb and bootstrap data-dependent linear programs, using primal-dual genericity to obtain uniform inference for their value functions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A complete facet catalogue turns each causal endpoint into a finite affine LP-value map, providing the representation needed for a non-deferred inference rung.

open_problems.open_problem: Derive sharp closed-form endpoints for each dose's unique-best probability under weak individual unimodality, prove that every endpoint is an extremum of affine combinations of at most three full facets, characterize when three are necessary, and construct endpoint-attaining response-triple mixtures.

source_refs.author: Jiannan Lu, Peng Ding, and Tirthankar Dasgupta
source_refs.venue: Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics

source_refs.claim: Functionals of joint potential-outcome distributions can be sharply bounded computationally under auxiliary constraints, without yielding the requested three-arm symbolic formulas.
source_refs.author: Thomas M. Russell

source_refs.excerpt: sharp threshold endpoints, explicit endpoint-attaining full laws, a sparse-flow construction
Extend the attainment construction to a jointly sharp vector of benefit, no-harm, and large-gain tier events

open_problems.why_unsolved: A unique-best-dose probability depends on the full coupling of three potential outcomes, whereas published symbolic ordinal bounds and the accepted partial-transport construction use two-way Fréchet or bipartite-flow geometry. Here the feasible coupling is three-marginal and excludes all strict-middle-valley cells. The first donor-proof step—reserving a threshold subflow in a bipartite graph—must therefore be replaced by a three-partite dual-basis decomposition over the canonical Q3,L facets and a forbidden-support completion argument. Neither the literature nor the mined proposals establish three-facet sufficiency, identify a marginal region where three are indispensable, or construct mixtures attaining every branch at ties and zero cells.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Three explicit finite max-min formulas in the randomized arm marginals, a proof that each optimizing dual certificate uses at most three canonical full facets, an open region where no one- or two-facet certificate is optimal, and exact response-triple mixtures attaining every endpoint branch.

writing_exemplar.why: It motivates person-level ordinal benefit probabilities, explains why randomization identifies only marginals, and makes symbolic sharpness the central deliverable.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Ordinal averages obscure who benefits -> randomization leaves cross-world association unidentified -> symbolic sharp bounds recover decision-relevant information -> extend pairwise benefit to a uniquely best dose among three

method_exemplars.technique: Encode deterministic response support restrictions in the transport problem and use Kantorovich duality to characterize sharp bounds.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Weak individual unimodality is a support restriction on a potential-outcome coupling, but the destination replaces the paper's two-marginal dual by a forbidden-support three-marginal dual.

method_exemplars.technique: Use cumulative marginal sums and constructive joint tables to prove sharp closed-form ordinal benefit bounds.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its cumulative transportation argument is the pairwise ordinal analogue of the prefix/suffix facet combinations and constructive attainment required here.

method_exemplars.technique: Use stochastic optimization and second-order asymptotic approximation to form confidence intervals for a sharp ordinal fraction-benefiting bound.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides a concrete estimation-and-inference template for a marginally identified ordinal cross-world probability; the new endpoints are its three-arm unique-best analogues.

open_problems.open_problem: Construct simultaneous support-aware inference for all six unique-best-dose endpoint coordinates that remains valid at zero arm cells and tied active facets while recovering pointwise scalar semiparametric efficiency on separated positive-support faces.

source_refs.author: JoonHwan Cho and Thomas M. Russell

open_problems.why_unsolved: Each endpoint is a finite minimum or maximum of affine functions of the three arm-specific multinomial probabilities. It is smooth when one facet is separated, directionally differentiable at facet ties, and restricted by a changing tangent cone when categories have zero or vanishing probability. General LP-value inference does not deliver exact-on-face support adaptation or scalar efficiency, while prior CausalSmith work settles only fixed separated faces and engineered changing-support arrays. The missing proof must jointly control support recovery, near-active facet selection, vanishing endpoint variance, and Gaussian critical-value transfer across six coordinates without sacrificing the efficient influence function on regular faces.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A fully specified plug-in endpoint estimator and common multiplier or Gaussian confidence region with uniform simultaneous coverage over product-multinomial triangular arrays allowing vanishing cells and facet ties, an explicit joint directional limit, and an oracle-equivalence theorem yielding each scalar efficient Wald interval on separated positive-support faces.

writing_exemplar.why: It treats sampling uncertainty around an optimized ordinal person-level bound as a substantive nonregular problem rather than a routine plug-in step.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Person-level ordinal effects are scientifically interpretable -> randomization only bounds them -> optimized endpoints create nonstandard sampling uncertainty -> three-dose reporting requires simultaneous inference robust to ties and sparse support

method_exemplars.technique: Bootstrap value functions of randomly perturbed linear programs and exploit generic primal-dual solutions for uniform validity.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Every desired endpoint is an LP value with data-dependent marginal constraints; the new result must refine this machinery using the explicit finite facet map and multinomial support.

method_exemplars.technique: Derive a Hadamard directional derivative and consistently simulate that derivative applied to the Gaussian limit.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The endpoint vector is a finite min-max map whose derivative takes extrema over active affine gradients at ties.

method_exemplars.technique: Localize the binding contact set and calibrate extrema of a common Gaussian process.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The simultaneous region must retain near-active canonical facets without paying for the whole catalogue on separated faces.

open_problems.open_problem: Quantify robustness of the three-dose unique-best probability bounds to violations of weak individual unimodality by allowing at most an epsilon fraction of strict-middle-valley response types and deriving the sharp breakdown frontier.

source_refs.claim: Breakdown frontiers characterize the weakest assumption relaxations preserving a substantive treatment-effect conclusion and support uniform confidence bands.
source_refs.author: Matthew A. Masten and Alexandre Poirier

source_refs.claim: Violations of IV monotonicity can be parameterized by the share of defiers and outcome-distribution differences to obtain sharp bounds and robust regions.
source_refs.author: Claudia Noack

source_refs.claim: The psilocybin trial randomized participants across 25 mg, 10 mg, and 1 mg arms and reported efficacy together with dose-related adverse-event information.
source_refs.author: Guy M. Goodwin et al.

open_problems.why_unsolved: Individual unimodality is an untestable cross-world support restriction, which is consequential for a benefit-risk outcome when efficacy and adverse effects can move differently with dose. Existing breakdown-frontier work relaxes random assignment, rank invariance, or binary-IV monotonicity rather than a forbidden subset of three-dose ordinal response types. The first proof step is to place an epsilon budget on the total mass of strict-middle-valley cells and determine how the endpoint dual and active canonical facets change with epsilon; neither pairwise ordinal formulas nor existing monotonicity-sensitivity analyses supply those breakpoints.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A sharp piecewise-affine formula for every endpoint as a function of epsilon, exact threshold values at which conclusions such as a positive lower bound on a dose's unique-best share cease to hold, endpoint-attaining mixtures on every segment, and valid confidence bands for the resulting breakdown points.

writing_exemplar.why: It makes the credibility of an untestable assumption transparent by asking for the weakest relaxation under which the substantive conclusion survives.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: A causal conclusion depends on an untestable assumption -> quantify how much failure the conclusion withstands -> encode robustness as a breakdown frontier -> apply that logic to three-dose individual unimodality

method_exemplars.technique: Introduce a population-share budget for response types violating monotonicity and solve for sharp identified distributions as the budget varies.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Strict middle valleys play the formal role of defier types, but the destination response space is a three-dose ordinal cube and the targets are unique-best probabilities.

method_exemplars.technique: Treat the breakdown frontier as a directionally differentiable functional and construct lower uniform bootstrap confidence bands.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The epsilon threshold is a causal partial-identification breakdown point with kinks caused by changes in the active affine facet.

method_exemplars.technique: Relax discrete causal assumptions inside a polynomial optimization program and recompute sharp or epsilon-sharp ranges.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A violation-mass budget is a linear relaxation of the forbidden-cell assumption and supplies a computational check for an eventual symbolic frontier.

literature_map:
Goodwin et al. (2022, NEJM, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2206443) supplies the three-dose application: 25 mg, 10 mg, and 1 mg randomized arms, with efficacy and dose-related adverse-event information.
Lu, Ding, and Dasgupta (2018, JEBS, arXiv:1507.01542) derive sharp symbolic bounds for pairwise ordinal probabilities of benefit and strict benefit from two potential-outcome marginals.
Chiba (2017, Statistics in Medicine, doi:10.1002/sim.7400) combines pairwise ordinal sharp bounds with exact randomization inference, but not three-arm unique-best probabilities.
Gabriel, Sachs, and Jensen (2024, Biometrika, arXiv:2305.10555) extend symbolic ordinal benefit and no-harm bounds, still for binary treatment contrasts.
Mullahy (2018, Journal of Health Economics/NBER w23603) emphasizes the policy value of inequality probabilities in health-outcome evaluation and their dependence on unidentified joint potential outcomes.
Balke and Pearl (1997, JASA, doi:10.1080/01621459.1997.10474074) establish the response-type linear-program template for sharp causal bounds; Bonet (2001, UAI, arXiv:1301.2258) is the closest causal facet-completeness precedent.
Demuynck (2015, Economics Letters, doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2015.09.042) shows how treatment-response shape restrictions enter linear programs and notes the growing difficulty of closed forms under combined restrictions.
Russell (2021, JBES, doi:10.1080/07350015.2019.1684300) sharply bounds functionals of joint potential-outcome laws computationally and permits auxiliary constraints.
Duarte et al. (2024, JASA, arXiv:2109.13471) automate general discrete causal bounds through polynomial programming but do not provide canonical analytic facets or all-support recurrences.
Kim (2014, arXiv:1410.5885) uses optimal-transport duality for treatment-effect distributions under support restrictions; the three-dose problem changes the first step to a forbidden-support multi-marginal dual.
Cho and Russell (2024, JBES, arXiv:1810.03180), Fang and Santos (2019, ReStud, arXiv:1404.3763), and Hong and Li (2018, Journal of Econometrics) supply complementary LP-value and directional-delta inference tools.
Huang et al. (2019, Biometrics, doi:10.1111/biom.13101) gives pointwise optimization-based inference for one two-arm fraction-benefiting estimand, leaving simultaneous support-face adaptation unresolved.
Masten and Poirier (2020, Quantitative Economics, arXiv:1705.04765) and Noack (2021, arXiv:2106.06421) provide breakdown-frontier and violation-mass templates, but not for three-dose ordinal unimodality.
Lin, Gao, Blanchet, and Glynn (2025–2026, AISTATS, arXiv:2506.00257) expose continuity and rate issues in covariate-assisted conditional optimal transport; He and Li (2026, arXiv:2605.11415) instead use a parametric copula sensitivity model for pairwise ordinal inference.
Targeted searches for three-treatment ordinal unique-best bounds, unimodal response-type facets, and conditional multi-marginal unique-best inference found pairwise comparisons and generic optimizers, but no theorem matching the requested three-dose weak-unimodality objects.
